name: The Church Of Christ
overview: The Church of Christ is established by Jesus as a divine institution, built upon the foundation of His authority and protected against the forces of evil, as affirmed in Matthew 16:18. It is described as the body of Christ, with Jesus as its head, holding preeminence over all things (Ephesians 1:22; Colossians 1:18). The church is precious, purchased by Christ's own blood, and entrusted to overseers who are called to shepherd the flock faithfully (Acts 20:28). Believers are united in this body, exemplified by mutual greetings among the churches of Christ, reflecting the unity and holiness that characterize His people (Romans 16:16).
